title: Gardening Workshop Registration
scene: A telephone conversation between a community centre clerk and a caller registering for a gardening workshop.
sample_context: Polite, transactional exchange covering course details, dates, spelling of names, and payment.

speakers.audio_profile: Soft, warm female clerk speaking clearly and politely.

director_note.disfluencies: Minimal; deliberate self-corrections on key data

speakers.audio_profile: Upbeat, polite male caller registering for a course.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Good morning, Westford Community Centre. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Hi there. I’m calling because I saw a flyer about some gardening workshops happening this spring, and I’d like to register.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Certainly! We have a few different gardening courses running this term. Are you interested in the vegetable growing course or the floral design one?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Actually, it was the urban balcony gardening workshop. I live in a flat and want to make the most of my small outdoor space.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Ah, yes. The "Balcony Blooms" workshop. That’s been very popular this year. It runs for four weeks. Let me just check if we still have places... Yes, we have two spots left.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Fantastic, I’ll take one of those.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Great. I’ll need to take down a few details to get you registered. Could I have your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Yes, it’s Arthur Pendelton.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Is that P-E-N-D-L-E-T-O-N?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: No, it’s P-E-N-D-E-L-T-O-N.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Got it, thank you. And what is your address, Arthur?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: I’m at Flat 4, 28 Rivermead Road.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Rivermead Road. And the postcode?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: It’s WE4 8TQ.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Thank you. Now, could I get a contact number for you? A mobile is best in case a tutor needs to cancel at the last minute.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Sure. My mobile number is 07700 900 415.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: 07700 900 415. Perfect. Now, the workshop starts on the 15th of April.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Oh, wait. The flyer I saw said it started on the 12th.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: The vegetable course starts on the 12th, but the balcony gardening one begins on Wednesday the 15th of April, from 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Okay, Wednesday the 15th. That works for me.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Now, for the fees. The full cost of the four-week course is £45. That includes all your soil and plant pots, but you will need to bring your own gloves.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: £45. That’s very reasonable. Does that include seeds as well?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Yes, a basic starter pack of seeds is included. But as I mentioned, we don’t supply the gloves for hygiene reasons, so please remember to bring a pair.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: I’ll make a note of that. How do I go about paying?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: You can pay over the phone right now with a credit card, or you can pay in cash when you arrive for the first session. However, we do require a £15 deposit upfront to secure your place.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: I can just pay the whole £45 by card right now if that’s easier.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: That would be brilliant. Before we do that, we have a quick health and safety questionnaire. Do you have any allergies we should be aware of? Sometimes we use different types of fertilizers.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: I don’t have any issues with fertilizers, but I am actually allergic to wasps. If I get stung, I need my medication.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I’ll note down "wasps" on your medical form. The tutors always carry a first aid kit, but make sure you bring any personal medication.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: I always do.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Excellent. One final thing, we are offering a 10% discount on the course fee if you are a registered student or a senior citizen. Do either of those apply to you?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Yes, I’m currently a part-time university student.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Oh, wonderful! In that case, I will apply the student discount. I just need to see your student card when you come in for the first class.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Will do. Thanks so much for your help.
